correctness.rationale: The code independently enumerates all 65536 induced subsets by union-find and a connected-component/edge-count test; both agree on 13839 faces. An explicit 6908-pair matching has 23 critical faces (nineteen in dimension five and four in dimension six), and acyclicity is certified by complete directed Hasse topological sorting over 77632 incidences. With ascending-vertex orientations, the exact signed gradient differential from four six-cells to nineteen five-cells has a 4x4 minor of determinant +1. The post-unmatching CW model has one zero-cell and cells only in degrees five and six, so the attaching maps are degree vectors and four primitive cancellations yield exactly fifteen five-spheres, integrally. Independent full original simplicial mod-two boundary ranks corroborate the homology. The complete 1920-element group actions preserve adjacency and their fixed-face Lefschetz characters all equal sign(sigma)*(fixed_vertices-1), proving the rational twisted augmentation character and five-plus-ten irreducible split.

value.rationale: The Clebsch graph is a canonical five-regular triangle-free strongly regular folded odd cube, and induced-forest faces are directly motivated by the established terminal forest filtration and feedback-vertex-set topology. Complete integral homotopy of its nonpure eight-dimensional vertex-set complex and the rational five-plus-ten module under all 1920 symmetries supply a natural structural invariant not implied by independence or neighborhood-complex results. The automorphism module determines nontrivial symmetry information beyond the sphere count. This is a complete finite classification rather than an arbitrary slice, routine normalization, or unmotivated table entry.
